dedupe_keys.name: impact of reliability parameters on o m cost and greenhouse gas emissions of offshore wind farms

description: Gräfe, Moritz and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The simulation uses Lillgrund SCADA and environmental conditions to vary critical component reliability by plus or minus fifty percent. It estimates costs, availability, interventions and vessel usage, with greenhouse emissions from vessel fuel and spare parts. The source reports conditional operational-expenditure and component-emission sensitivities. This is an operations-and-maintenance footprint, not a complete wind-farm life-cycle inventory. Relationships between loading and failures remain a stated research limitation; public access to the input observations is not established. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The maintenance simulation is based on Lillgrund operating and environmental data.
